paper_title: Tool-Star Empowering LLM-Brained Multi-Tool Reasoner via Reinforcement   Learning
caption: Performance Comparison of Tool-Star(3B) in Local and Web Search Modes

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The provided bar chart, titled "Different Search Mode," visually compares the overall performance of the Tool-Star-3B model under two distinct search configurations: "Local" and "Web," across four different datasets labeled on the horizontal axis as "HotpotQA," "2Wiki," "MuSiQue," and "Bamboogle." The vertical axis, labeled "Overall Performance," is scaled linearly from 0 to 70, with tick marks and grid lines at regular intervals of 10 units, and the performance values are presented in unspecified units. The horizontal axis is organized in the order of the datasets listed, without any explicit indication of a specific sorting criterion beyond the sequence presented. Each dataset is represented by two adjacent bars: a light blue bar corresponding to "Tool-Star-3B(Local)" and a dark blue bar corresponding to "Tool-Star-3B(Web)," as indicated by the legend in the upper left corner. The bars are uniformly spaced and do not exhibit any visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or highlighting. The performance values for the "Local" mode are approximately 52 for "HotpotQA," 40 for "2Wiki," 20 for "MuSiQue," and 53 for "Bamboogle." The corresponding values for the "Web" mode are approximately 51 for "HotpotQA," 54 for "2Wiki," 21 for "MuSiQue," and 61 for "Bamboogle." The chart does not include any additional annotations or comparative indicators beyond the visual representation of the bars.
model_annotations.German: The provided bar chart, titled "Different Search Mode," visually compares the "Overall Performance" of the Tool-Star-3B model across two search modes—"Local" (represented by light blue bars) and "Web" (represented by dark blue bars)—for four distinct datasets: HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle. The horizontal axis lists these four datasets in the order presented, while the vertical axis, labeled "Overall Performance," is scaled linearly from 0 to 70, with tick marks and labels at regular intervals of 10 units. Each dataset is represented by a pair of adjacent bars, one for each search mode, allowing for a direct visual comparison of performance within each category. For HotpotQA, the local mode achieves a performance of approximately 52, while the web mode reaches about 50. In the 2Wiki dataset, the local mode scores around 40 and the web mode around 52. For MuSiQue, both modes show similar performance, with the local mode at approximately 20 and the web mode slightly higher at about 21. In the Bamboogle dataset, the local mode scores approximately 53, and the web mode achieves the highest performance on the chart at approximately 61. The chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars by value or any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding for specific bars.
